purpose: Frozen full M4 null/power/invariance calibration package for FJS scientific recenter stage 3.

notes: This manifest freezes calibration design only.
Synthetic outcomes are mechanism calibration, not empirical headline evidence.
Real-data claims remain blocked until the later WRDS/public development and holdout stages.

null_family.rule: Cell passes when selected threshold has empirical FPR <= alpha under the frozen null design.

power_family.rule: Power is measured and archived per cell; no retrospective threshold retuning is allowed.

execution.process_parallelism: outer-cell process pool; one calibration kernel per worker
execution.resume_policy: skip valid completed cell checkpoints and re-reduce final artifacts deterministically
